todos.description: Implement dft_calculator.py with a working DFT wrapper (e.g., using ASE to run Quantum ESPRESSO) that computes electron-phonon coupling and Tc for candidate structures, or provide a clear interface to external DFT codes.

Implement scripts/generate_candidates.py with candidate generation logic: read from data/superconductor_database.json, apply ML models, and implement the multi-criteria decision support algorithm (weighted scoring) described in docs/discovery_strategy.md.

Implement scripts/predict_tc.py with Tc prediction logic (e.g., McMillan-Allen-Dynes equation or a trained ML model) that accepts composition/structure and outputs predicted Tc with confidence interval.
Implement run_pipeline.py to orchestrate the full discovery pipeline: load data, run generate_candidates, predict_tc, score candidates, and output results to data/experimental_results.json.

Populate data/superconductor_database.json with real superconductor data (composition, Tc, pressure, structure) from the SuperCon database or literature, ensuring at least 50 entries to support ML training and candidate screening.

Implement missing functions (fetch_materials_project, fetch_icsd, fetch_arxiv) in scripts/api_client.py or rewrite tests to use PipelineClient methods (e.g., get_candidates). Also correct patch targets to match requests.Session usage.

Consolidate duplicate documentation files: keep root-level candidate_materials.md as authoritative, update docs/candidate_materials.md to reference it or remove; ensure consistency between root and docs versions of discovery_strategy.md and other duplicated files.

Update proposed_chemistry_physics.md to include a dedicated 'Scalability Analysis for Top Candidate' subsection for YH10 (or the highest-scoring compound) covering pressure reduction via chemical precompression, precursor costs, thin-film stabilization, and a pathway to ambient-pressure synthesis.
